techs.description: The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. With so many ships, and such a high reliance on them, the Irassians were powerless to quarantine the disease that would claim their empire.

techs.description: The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays.

techs.description: A highly effective hull auto-repair system comprised of billions of microscopic nanomachines was found among the smoking remains of the Scavenger, and has been repurposed for our uses. techs.name: Starbase Construction
techs.description: A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.

techs.name: Starport
techs.description: The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.

techs.name: Starhold
techs.description: As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.

techs.name: Star Fortress
techs.description: These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.

techs.name: Citadel
techs.description: Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.

techs.name: Orbital Habitats
techs.description: Allows the construction of largely self-sustaining Orbital Habitats.

techs.name: Habitat Expansion
techs.description: Our early habitats were primitive things compared to the efficient designs we can now develop.

techs.name: Modular Engineering
techs.description: Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.

techs.name: Corps of Engineers
techs.description: The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.

scripted.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Carrier Operations
techs.description: These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.

techs.name: Improved Strike Craft
techs.description: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.

techs.name: Advanced Strike Craft
techs.description: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.

techs.name: Skravird Strike Craft
techs.description: Learning from the design expertise of Skrand and his people, these superior strike craft are capable of prolonged engagement and highly adaptive tactics.

techs.name: Interplanetary Expeditionary Forces
techs.description: The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.

techs.name: Nanocomposite Materials
techs.description: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.

techs.name: Ceramo-Metal Materials
techs.description: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.

techs.name: Plasteel Materials
techs.description: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.

techs.name: Durasteel Materials
techs.description: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.

techs.name: Neutronium Materials
techs.description: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.

techs.name: Crystal-Infused Plating
techs.description: By infusing armor plating with Crystalline matter we are able to further increase the durability of our ships' protective hulls.

techs.name: Crystal-Forged Plating
techs.description: Introducing Crystalline matter into the forging process further improves the ultra-hard qualities of crystal-infused metals.

techs.name: Armor Hardening
techs.description: Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.

techs.name: Adaptive Armor Hardening
techs.description: Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.

techs.name: Chemical Thrusters
techs.description: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function.

techs.name: Ion Thrusters
techs.description: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Plasma Thrusters
techs.description: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Impulse Thrusters
techs.description: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.

techs.name: Deep Space Defenses
techs.description: This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.

techs.name: Improved Structural Integrity
techs.description: A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.

techs.name: Industrial Base
techs.description: The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.

techs.name: Mechanized Mining
techs.description: The application of mechanical engineering to mineral extraction is a fundamental requirement for any industrial society.

techs.name: Powered Exoskeletons
techs.description: Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious, but it will also increase labor efficiency.

techs.name: Zero-G Refineries
techs.description: The addition of internal refineries on mining stations will substantially increase mineral production.

techs.name: Long-Range Mineral Scanners
techs.description: Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.

techs.name: Mineral Cutting Beams
techs.description: These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.

techs.name: Autonomous Mining Drones
techs.description: Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.

techs.name: Nanite Mineral Probes
techs.description: These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.

techs.name: Geothermal Fracking
techs.description: New fracking techniques will allow us to tap into previously unattainable pockets of geothermal resources deep beneath the planet's crust.

techs.name: Deep Core Mining
techs.description: These massive drills are needed to access the rich mineral deposits that can often be found close to a planet's core.

techs.name: Mineral Isolation
techs.description: Advanced spectrometry combines with fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth deposits.

techs.name: Loader Efficiency

techs.name: Assembly Algorithms

techs.description: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.

techs.name: Coilguns

techs.name: Railguns
techs.description: The latest in electromagnetic accelerators, railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.

techs.name: Advanced Railguns
techs.description: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.

techs.name: Gauss Cannons

techs.name: Kinetic Battery
techs.description: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.

techs.name: Kinetic Artillery

techs.name: Giga Cannon

techs.name: Autocannons

techs.name: Ripper Cannons

techs.name: Stormfire Cannons
techs.description: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.

techs.name: Flak Battery
techs.description: Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.

techs.name: Flak Cannons
techs.description: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.

techs.name: Flak Artillery
techs.description: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.

techs.name: Nuclear Missiles

techs.name: Arkship Mastery
techs.description: The pinnacle of mobile megastructure engineering. These Arkships represent the full extent of what a traveling civilization can achieve.

techs.name: Civilian Arkships
techs.description: More than a vessel, the Civilian Arkship is a world unto itself. Its infrastructure supports a complete society in motion, carrying with it everything needed to thrive across the stars.

techs.name: Scientific Arkships
techs.description: Scientific Arkships combine the mobility of nomadic life with the full resources of a dedicated research institution, turning every system we visit into a new opportunity for discovery.

techs.name: Military Arkships
techs.description: Military Arkships are the armored core of a nomadic empire. Purpose-built for combat, they carry devastating firepower wherever the fleet travels.

techs.name: Planetary Reprocessor
techs.description: Smaller celestial bodies can be crushed and processed in these enormous gears, providing us with a bounty of materials.

techs.description: These shipboard lab facilities incorporate advanced technologies from the ancient Curator Order to further increase survey speeds.

techs.name: Curator Archaeology Lab
techs.description: A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.

techs.name: Zero-G Laboratories
techs.description: A lot of critical research can only be done in a zero gravity environment, which these specialized laboratories are eminently designed for.

techs.name: Miniature Containment Fields
techs.description: Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.

techs.name: Quantum Probes
techs.description: Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.

techs.name: Autonomous Station Protocols
techs.description: Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.

techs.name: Multi-Dimensional Analysis
techs.description: Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.

techs.name: Quantum Computing
techs.description: With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.

techs.name: Unified Field Theory
techs.description: The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.

techs.name: Quantum Gravitational Waves
techs.description: We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.

techs.name: Administrative AI
techs.description: Organizational circuitry rerouting academic fervor.

techs.name: Automated Colony Ships
techs.description: By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.

techs.name: Self-Aware Colony Ships
techs.description: Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.

techs.name: Self-Evolving Logic
techs.description: Introspective prioritization.

techs.name: Automated Exploration Protocols
techs.description: An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.

techs.name: Positronic AI
techs.description: Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.

techs.name: Positronic Implants
techs.description: Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.

techs.name: Specialized Combat Computers
techs.description: Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.

techs.name: Autonomous Ship Intellects
techs.description: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.

techs.name: Quantum Firewalls
techs.description: Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.

techs.name: Simultaneous-Collapse Storage
techs.description: Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.

techs.name: Negative-Time Keys
techs.description: Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.

techs.name: Quantum Hacking
techs.description: Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.

techs.name: Simulated Social Engineering
techs.description: The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.

techs.name: Quasi-Dimensional Reflection
techs.description: Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.

techs.name: Fission Power
techs.description: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.

techs.name: Fusion Power
techs.description: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Cold Fusion Power
techs.description: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Antimatter Power
techs.description: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Zero Point Power
techs.description: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.

condition.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: Reactor Boosters
techs.description: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.

techs.name: Improved Reactor Boosters
techs.description: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.

techs.name: Advanced Reactor Boosters
techs.description: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.

techs.name: Deflectors
techs.description: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.

techs.name: Improved Deflectors
techs.description: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.

techs.name: Shields
techs.description: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.

techs.name: Advanced Shields
techs.description: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.

techs.name: Hyper Shields
techs.description: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.

techs.name: Shield Capacitors
techs.description: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.

techs.name: Shield Hardening
techs.description: With these modifications, the fields generated by our shield emitters will partially deflect attacks that would otherwise bypass the shields.

techs.name: Advanced Shield Hardening
techs.description: Zro particles raised to a high energy state add fluctuations to our shields that can deflect certain weapons that would otherwise easily penetrate the fields.

techs.name: Planetary Shields
techs.description: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

techs.name: Gravitic Sensors
techs.description: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.

techs.name: Subspace Sensors
techs.description: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.

techs.name: Tachyon Sensors
techs.description: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.

techs.name: High-Energy Capacitors
techs.description: Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy is one of the cornerstones for any modern civilization.

techs.name: Field Modulation
techs.description: Modulated fields allow for increased production and improved energy yield.

techs.name: Quantum Energy States
techs.description: Basic entanglement principles applied to energy generation provide a substantial increase in energy output.

techs.name: Quantum Field Manipulation
techs.description: Quantum superposition of energy coils, simultaneously drained and charged.

techs.name: Jump Drive
techs.description: A groundbreaking technological marvel, the Jump Drive shreds the local space-time continuum and rearranges it on the quantum level to be identical to that of the target destination - and thus the ship appears to near-instantly "jump" from system to system.

scripted.text: At least one of the following

techs.name: FTL Inhibition
techs.description: Gravity well projectors can be used to create localized pockets of space where safe entry into hyperspace is impossible. The immense power requirements and the size of the projectors prohibits their use on anything smaller than a space station.

techs.name: Applied Superconductivity
techs.description: Minor improvements to transmission efficiency adds up to a sizeable reduction in overall energy loss.

techs.name: Shield Harmonics
techs.description: The basic mechanics of ship shields are complex, but they can be adjusted and improved in a multitude of ways.

techs.name: Focusing Arrays
techs.description: Perfecting the firing cadence of laser weaponry is a task that could keep the engineering elite of any given planet busy for centuries.

techs.name: Flash Coolant
techs.description: New developments in tech cooling regularly surface, improving the stability and efficiency of our weapons systems, keeping them from blowing up the ships upon which they are mounted.

techs.name: Gravitational Analysis
techs.description: Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.

techs.name: Red Lasers
techs.description: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.

techs.name: Blue Lasers
techs.description: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.

techs.name: UV Lasers
techs.description: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.

techs.name: X-Ray Lasers
techs.description: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.

techs.name: Gamma Lasers
techs.description: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.

techs.name: Particle Lances
techs.description: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage. The size of the emitter arrays limits their use to battleships and titans.

techs.name: Tachyon Lances
techs.description: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power. Like its predecessor, its use is limited to battleships and titans.

techs.name: Plasma Throwers
techs.description: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor.

techs.name: Plasma Accelerators
techs.description: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.

techs.name: Plasma Cannons
techs.description: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.

techs.name: Arc Emitters
techs.description: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at targets, which in part can ignore armor and shields.

techs.name: Focused Arc Emitters
techs.description: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.

techs.name: Disruptors
techs.description: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together. They are capable of passing through shields and armor to wreak havoc directly on enemy hull and crew.

techs.name: Ion Disruptors
techs.description: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets.

techs.name: Phase Disruptors
techs.description: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.

techs.name: Proton Launchers
techs.description: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.

techs.name: Neutron Launchers
techs.description: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.

techs.name: Active Countermeasures
techs.description: The best defense is a good offense.

techs.name: Interlinked Support Systems
techs.description: Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.

techs.name: Predictive Algorithms
techs.description: Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.

techs.name: Extradimensional Weaponry
techs.description: Applying 5th-dimensional energy manipulation principles on lower dimensional planes allows for the creation of powerful energy weapons.

techs.name: Mining Drone Lasers
techs.description: Using intense-focus lenses in combination with an oscillating firing frequency help create lasers strong enough to mine asteroids, or shoot down hostiles.

techs.name: Cloud Lightning Conduits
techs.description: Void Clouds use the electrical charges generated by the dense gases that make up most of their core to release bolts of burning plasma. Using the same gas composition together with a specialized conduit allows for powerful lightning weaponry.

techs.name: Null Void Beam
techs.description: By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.

techs.name: Starfire Cannon
techs.description:
Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships.

techs.name: Fruit Gardens
techs.description: Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna.

techs.name: Psionic Aura
techs.description: Psionic emanations from the Shroud bring an entity's favor into corporeal reality. An empire attuned to a Shroud patron will emit a Psionic Aura from where their psionic populations are concentrated.

techs.name: Psionic Aura Intensification

techs.name: Psionic Suppression

techs.name: Aura Resonation

techs.name: Materiality Engine
techs.description: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The Materiality Engine exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.

techs.name: Psionic Bombers
techs.description: These small and nimble craft specialize in delivering concentrated payloads of psionic energy. The larger the target, the greater resonance its explosions achieve.

techs.name: Psionic Lightning
techs.description: By establishing a temporary psionic connection between one ship and another, a direct charge of mental power can be discharged to devastating effect. Such raw energy is capable of confusing ship systems and influencing the minds of the crew within.

techs.description: By engaging in free trade of goods and services we allow for a more specialized economy, where an individual can excel in a narrow field and trade for their needs.

techs.description: Are the precognitive powers of Numa at work or is it a matter of skilled craftsmanship? Either way this galactic stock market prediction model will forecast fluctuations in the economy with divine accuracy.

techs.name: Nerve Dampeners
techs.description: Careful tuning of pain receptors allow soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.

techs.name: Cell Revitalization
techs.description: Regimens of periodic cell revitalization treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.

techs.name: Fleet Management Procedures
techs.description: Improved fleet management procedures will free up the resources needed to maintain a bigger fleet.

techs.name: Admiralty Support Staff
techs.description: Improving the support staff available to our commanders will increase the number of ships they can lead in a single fleet.

techs.name: Interstellar Expansion
techs.description: The immense logistical support networks needed to maintain an upgraded Starbase can be further improved, allowing us to support more of these stations.

techs.name: Synapse Interceptors
techs.description: Increasing the speed at which fighter pilots can process and act upon enemy positioning data elevates strike craft a few steps up the food chain.

techs.name: Iterative Pilot Training
techs.description: By collecting and analyzing the performance data of the pilots that came before, we have exponentially improved our pilot training methods. Each one will be quicker than the one that came before.

techs.name: Flagella Weaponization
techs.description: By altering the breeding process of Space Amoebas, we can program their symbiotic flagella to act as organic strike craft for our navy.

techs.name: Swarm Spawning Pools
techs.description: Collecting specimens from defeated Prethoryn enables us to clone and genetically program a war-brood of our own.

techs.name: Scourge Missiles
techs.description: By analyzing the biological weaponry employed by the Swarm we can create self-propelled projectiles weapons spreading the very same horrific destruction.

techs.name: Frequency Tuning
techs.description: Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.

techs.name: Enhanced Cryosleep Sedatives
techs.description: Sedatives based on a rare enzyme enable enhanced cryosleep, greatly improving organic species' tolerance of long-distance space travel.

techs.name: Universal Macrophage
techs.description: These powerful immunology boosters make disease a thing of the past, allowing organic populations to live fuller, healthier lives. May cause serious side effects.

techs.name: Living Metal
techs.description: Mining and processing the rare living metals is exceedingly difficult, but successful application of the mutable alloys yields incomparable advantages.

techs.name: Betharian Refining
techs.description: The Betharian minerals appear to have originated from singular source, but were scattered across the galaxy millennia ago. The minerals are most often encountered as pebble-sized clusters, and are highly flammable.

techs.name: Mote Stabilization
techs.description: Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.
